root_cause.text: The Bluetooth L2CAP subsystem fails to validate that incoming Enhanced Credit Based Connection Requests (`L2CAP_ECRED_CONN_REQ`) use unique command identifiers, allowing multiple requests with the same identifier to be marked as pending and causing a buffer overflow in `l2cap_ecred_rsp_defer`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a check in `l2cap_ecred_conn_req` using `__l2cap_chan_list_id(conn, cmd->ident, l2cap_ecred_list_defer, &num_scid)` to reject requests with `L2CAP_CR_LE_INVALID_PARAMS` if there are already pending channels with the same identifier (`cmd->ident`). The commit message confirms that accepting requests regardless of the command identifier "may cause multiple requests to be marked as pending (FLAG_DEFER_SETUP) which can cause more than L2CAP_ECRED_MAX_CID(5) to be allocated in l2cap_ecred_rsp_defer causing an overflow."
